newsitem.title: MOROCCO: British woman gang-raped in Morocco - paper.
newsitem.headline: British woman gang-raped in Morocco - paper.

text.p: A Moroccan man, angered when his British girlfriend refused to help him settle in Britain, kept her captive in his home and invited his friends to rape her, a Moroccan newspaper said on Sunday.

Assiyassa al Jadida newspaper printed a picture of the woman, a 44-year-old legal worker from Birmingham, who it said arrived last week in the Moroccan town of Kenitra after corresponding and talking by telephone to the Moroccan man.
It did not say whether they had met before.
It said she had come to visit her boyfriend and his family, only to find he was more interested in legal links with her through marriage, which would help him settle in Britain.
"When she rejected his ill-intentioned demand, she was locked in the home for three days from June 15 until June 17 where she suffered inhuman behaviour," the newspaper said.
She managed to escape and fled to the nearby police station where she was held in custody for 24 hours, the newspaper added.
"The worst (aspect) was the invitation by the man to his friends, who sexually assaulted her. She was exposed to savage sexual violence and was beaten," said Assiyassa al Jadida.
